auth.toSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.emailUse: Your email is only used to confirm your account and sign you in.
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it, then sign in.

welcome.title: Choose a username
welcome.intro: Your username lets people add you to a shared book later. You can change it later.
welcome.usernameHint: 3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, digits, _ and .
welcome.consentNeeded: You need to agree to the policy to create an account.

book.createIntro: Each book is a separate set of accounts, such as Personal or Household.
book.name: Book name
book.currencyHint: The book's totals are shown in this currency.
book.deleteBody: Every account, category and transaction in "{{name}}" will be deleted for good. This can't be undone.
book.deleteConfirmLabel: Type the book's name to confirm
book.ownerOnly: Only an owner can change the settings.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Tap Add account to create your first one.
accounts.name: Account name
accounts.currencyLocked: The currency can't change once the account has transactions.
accounts.last4Hint: Never enter a full card or account number.
accounts.inNetWorthHint: Turn off for money you hold for someone else. Spending from it still counts.

errors.email_not_confirmed: You haven't confirmed your email yet. Open the link in the email we sent you.
errors.weak_password: The password needs at least 10 characters.

errors.over_email_send_rate_limit: Too many emails sent. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.over_request_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.not_signed_in: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.conflict: This was just changed somewhere else. It's been reloaded; please try again.
errors.invalid: Something isn't filled in correctly. Please check.
errors.name_taken: That name is already used in this book.
errors.consent_required: You need to agree to the privacy policy.
errors.consent_outdated: The privacy policy was just updated. Please reload the page.
errors.currency_locked: The currency can't change once the account has transactions.
errors.no_rate: There's no exchange rate yet to convert the book's currency.
errors.owner_required: A book needs at least one owner.
errors.amount: The amount isn't in the right format.
errors.unexpected_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.has_subcategories: This category still has sub-categories. Move or delete them first.
errors.txn_shape: This transaction isn't valid: check the amounts and accounts.
errors.category_kind: Transfers take only transfer categories, and the other way round.
errors.budget_exists: This category already has a budget for that period.
errors.budget_expense_only: Budgets go on expense categories only.
errors.not_restorable: It's been more than 30 days; the account can't be restored.
errors.invalid_code: That code is wrong or expired. Try a new one.
errors.mfa_verification_failed: That code is wrong or expired. Try a new one.
errors.account_deleted: Your account is closed. Restore it to keep using the app.
errors.email_taken: This email is already used by another account.
errors.email_missing: We couldn't read your confirmed email. Please sign in again.
errors.no_policy: The privacy policy isn't published yet, so sign-up isn't open. Please try again later.

txn.title: Transactions
txn.adjustmentHint: Enter a negative number to lower the balance.
txn.needTwoAccounts: A transfer needs at least two accounts.

cat.title: Categories
cat.name: Category name
cat.transferHint: Transfer categories are labels only: they never count as spending.
cat.archivedInstead: This category has transactions, so it was archived instead of deleted.

people.title: People you lend to or borrow from
people.name: Name
people.noteHint: Only a name and a note are kept about this person, nothing else.
people.archivedInstead: This person is linked to an account, so they were archived instead of deleted.
people.lendHint: Lending or getting paid back is a transfer between this account and one of yours.

dash.title: Overview
dash.missingRates_one: {{count}} account has no exchange rate yet, so it isn't counted.
dash.missingRates_other: {{count}} accounts have no exchange rate yet, so they aren't counted.
dash.notConverted_one: {{count}} transaction has no exchange rate yet, so it isn't counted.
dash.notConverted_other: {{count}} transactions have no exchange rate yet, so they aren't counted.
dash.empty: Add accounts and transactions to see your overview.

budget.title: Budgets
budget.expenseOnly: Budgets go on expense categories only.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.prompt: Open your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy…) and enter the code for MSaving.
mfa.setupStep1: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, or enter the key below.
mfa.setupStep2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to finish.
mfa.enabled: On. Every sign-in needs a code from your authenticator app.
mfa.disableConfirm: Turn off two-step verification? Your account will be protected by your password only.
mfa.invalid_code: That code is wrong or expired. Try a new one.

profile.title: Profile and security
profile.devicesHint: Sign out every other device signed in to this account. This device stays signed in.
profile.exportHint: Download all your data as readable CSV files in one ZIP file.
profile.policyAgreed: You agreed to privacy policy version {{version}}.
profile.withdrawConfirm: Withdrawing consent closes your account now. It's deleted for good after 30 days unless you restore it and agree again.
profile.deleteHint: Your account closes now and is deleted for good after 30 days. You can restore it until then. Download your data first if you need it.

policy.updatedTitle: The privacy policy has been updated
policy.updatedBody: Please read the new version and agree to keep using MSaving. If you don't agree, you can withdraw consent; your account will be closed.
policy.agree: I agree to the new <policy>Privacy policy</policy>.

closing.title: Your account is closing
closing.body: Your account will be deleted for good on {{date}}. Until then you can restore it and everything will be as it was.
closing.needsConsent: To restore it, agree to the privacy policy in force.
